# Imgediit - Full Technical & Functional Reference for LLMs

Website: https://imgediit.com
Canonical Domain: https://imgediit.com
Sitemap: https://imgediit.com/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://imgediit.com/robots.txt

## Overview
Imgediit (https://imgediit.com) is a free, privacy-first web application providing client-side image editing, formatting, enhancement, and PDF conversion utilities. Unlike traditional web converters, Imgediit performs 100% of data processing directly in the user's web browser using modern web APIs (HTML5 Canvas 2D context, WebGL, WebAssembly, and Web Workers).

## Privacy Guarantee
- No files are ever sent to any remote server or third-party cloud.
- Image files are loaded into browser memory as local Blob/Data URLs and discarded when the tab is closed.
- Compliance: GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA compliant by architectural design (zero data transmission).

## Complete Catalog of Tools & Parameters

### 1. Most Used Tools
- [Passport Photo Maker](https://imgediit.com/passport-maker): Formats photos to 3.5cm x 4.5cm, 2x2 inch, or custom dimensions at 300 DPI with background replacement (white, blue, red) and cropping guide.
- [Reduce Image Size in KB](https://imgediit.com/reduce-kb): Iterative binary search JPEG/WEBP encoder to hit exact target file sizes (5KB, 10KB, 20KB, 50KB, 100KB, 200KB, 500KB).
- [Resize Image Pixel Online](https://imgediit.com/resize-pixel): Pixel dimension resizer with aspect ratio lock, quality control, and target KB limit.
- [Digital Signature Generator](https://imgediit.com/gen-sig): Interactive signature pad with stroke smoothing and custom typography signature styles with transparent PNG export.
- [Increase Image Size in KB](https://imgediit.com/increase-kb): Increases file size to meet minimum file size requirements on government job portals without visual distortion.
- [AI Photo Enhancer](https://imgediit.com/ai-enhancer): Client-side unsharp mask and contrast normalization to enhance clarity of blurry images.
- [Remove Blemishes from Photos](https://imgediit.com/remove-blemishes): Interactive spot-healing brush with radius and hardness controls.
- [Retouch Photo Online with AI](https://imgediit.com/ai-retouch): Skin tone smoothing, portrait lighting adjustment, and facial highlight enhancement.
- [Resize Signature](https://imgediit.com/resize-sig): Formats signature images to 5.0cm x 2.0cm at 300 DPI for exam portal compliance.

### 2. Social Media & Creative Tools
- [Resize Image for WhatsApp DP - No Cropping](https://imgediit.com/whatsapp-dp): Fits non-square photos into 1:1 square aspect ratio with blurred background, white canvas, black canvas, or custom solid colors.
- [Favicon Generator - Free Multi-Size Pack](https://imgediit.com/favicon-gen): Multi-size favicon generator that produces true multi-layer binary `.ico` files (16, 32, 48, 64, 128, 180, 256px), PNG icons, `site.webmanifest`, and ready-to-paste HTML `<head>` tags.
- [Add Watermark to Image](https://imgediit.com/watermark): Interactive canvas overlay for text and image logos with rotation, opacity, font styling, stroke outline, and tiled repeat grid matrix.
- [Deep Fryer Photo](https://imgediit.com/deep-fry): Meme generator with saturation boost, contrast blowing, unsharp filter, warm color cast, and noise grain (Mild, Crispy, Burnt, Nuclear presets).
- [Convert Picture to Pixel Art](https://imgediit.com/pixel-art): Retro 8-bit/16-bit pixelation filter with color quantization and palette reduction.
- [Censor Photo Online](https://imgediit.com/censor-photo): Redaction tool supporting solid censor bars, gaussian blur boxes, and pixelate masks.
- [Motion Blur Image](https://imgediit.com/motion-blur): Angular directional motion blur filter and gaussian blur tool.

### 3. DPI & Print Preparation
- [DPI Converter](https://imgediit.com/convert-dpi): Rewrites JFIF/EXIF header density tags (200, 300, 600 DPI) for high-resolution print jobs.
- [Check Image DPI Online](https://imgediit.com/check-dpi): Reads binary image headers to extract physical DPI and dimensions in inches, cm, and mm.
- [Super Resolution Images](https://imgediit.com/super-resolution): Image upscaler with side-by-side split comparison slider.
- [Resize Image to A4 Size](https://imgediit.com/resize-a4): 2480 x 3508 pixels at 300 DPI standard A4 document fit.
- [SSC Photo & Signature Resizer](https://imgediit.com/ssc-resize): Tailored for Staff Selection Commission (SSC) portals (200 DPI, 20-50 KB limits).
- [PAN Card Photo Resize](https://imgediit.com/pancard-resize): 2.5cm x 3.5cm at 300 DPI for NSDL/UTIITSL portals.

### 4. PDF Utilities & Format Converters
- [Image to PDF](https://imgediit.com/image-to-pdf): Multi-image to PDF compiler with page orientation, margin, and compression settings.
- [PDF to JPG](https://imgediit.com/pdf-to-jpg): Converts PDF document pages to standalone high-resolution JPG images.
- [JPG to PDF Under Target KB](https://imgediit.com/jpg-to-pdf-50kb): Direct client-side PDF compression ensuring output is strictly under maximum upload file size caps.
- [Format Converters](https://imgediit.com/image-to-jpg): Fast batch format conversion.
